verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU server hardware (DGX/HGX system), not a software application that manages user items. Bulk operations across many items is an application or data-management UX axis, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers compute specs, power, networking and BMC/Redfish/IPMI management, none of which describes a bulk-operation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
